changeSet.author: Tomislav Duric
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [dbo].[IntersectTypeDetail] AS SELECT IT.uid, IT.ID, IT.Subject, IT.SubjectID, IT.SubjectCardinality, CASE IT.Subject WHEN 'IntersectType' THEN utility.DeriveIntersectTypeName(SIT.ID) WHEN 'GroupType' THEN 'Group' WHEN 'ResourceType' THEN 'Resource' ELSE COALESCE (SFT.TextPath, SATT.Name, SDT.Name) END AS SubjectName, COALESCE (SIcon.IconBackColor, '#000') AS SubjectIconBackColor, COALESCE (SIcon.IconForeColor, '#fff') AS SubjectIconForeColor, COALESCE (SIcon.IconText, SUBSTRING(COALESCE (SATT.Name, SDT.Name, ''), 1, 2)) AS SubjectIconText, IT.Object, IT.ObjectID, IT.ObjectCardinality, CASE IT.Object WHEN 'IntersectType' THEN utility.DeriveIntersectTypeName(OIT.ID) WHEN 'GroupType' THEN 'Group' WHEN 'ResourceType' THEN 'Resource' ELSE COALESCE (OFT.TextPath, OATT.Name, ODT.Name) END AS ObjectName, COALESCE (OIcon.IconBackColor, '#000') AS ObjectIconBackColor, COALESCE (OIcon.IconForeColor, '#fff') AS ObjectIconForeColor, COALESCE (OIcon.IconText, SUBSTRING(COALESCE (OATT.Name, ODT.Name, ''), 1, 2)) AS ObjectIconText, IT.PredicateID, P.Name AS PredicateName, P.Inverse AS PredicateInverse, P.Type AS PredicateType, COALESCE (IT.IsSystem, CAST(0 AS bit)) AS IsSystem FROM dbo.IntersectType AS IT WITH (nolock) LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.Predicate AS P WITH (nolock) ON P.ID = IT.PredicateID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AssetType AS SATT WITH (nolock) ON SATT.Object = IT.Subject AND SATT.ObjectID = IT.SubjectID AND IT.Subject <> 'FusionAttributeType' LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.FusionAttributeType AS SFT WITH (nolock) ON SFT.ID = IT.SubjectID AND IT.Subject = 'FusionAttributeType' LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT 1 AS ID, 'Reference List' AS Name) AS SDT ON IT.Subject = 'ReferenceItemType' AND IT.SubjectID = 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.IntersectType AS SIT WITH (nolock) ON IT.Subject = 'IntersectType' AND SIT.ID = IT.SubjectID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.AssetType AS OATT WITH (nolock) ON OATT.Object = IT.Object AND OATT.ObjectID = IT.ObjectID AND IT.Object <> 'FusionAttributeType' LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.FusionAttributeType AS OFT WITH (nolock) ON OFT.ID = IT.ObjectID AND IT.Object = 'FusionAttributeType' LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.IntersectType AS OIT WITH (nolock) ON IT.Object = 'IntersectType' AND OIT.ID = IT.ObjectID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT 0 AS ID, 'Reference List' AS Name) AS ODT ON IT.Object = 'ReferenceItemType' AND IT.ObjectID = 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.ObjectStyle AS SIcon WITH (nolock) ON SIcon.ObjectType = IT.Subject AND SIcon.ObjectID = IT.SubjectID LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.ObjectStyle AS OIcon WITH (nolock) ON OIcon.ObjectType = IT.Object AND OIcon.ObjectID = IT.ObjectID WHERE (COALESCE (SATT.ID, SFT.ID, SDT.ID, SIT.ID) IS NOT NULL) AND (COALESCE (OATT.ID, OFT.ID, ODT.ID, OIT.ID) IS NOT NULL)
